{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute average revenue by channel within each segment
avg_revenue_by_segment_channel = df_filtered.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['revenue_clean'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute the difference in average revenue between email and paid_search within each segment
differences = []
for segment in df_filtered['customer_segment'].unique():
    segment_data = avg_revenue_by_segment_channel[avg_revenue_by_segment_channel['customer_segment'] == segment]
    email_rev = segment_data[segment_data['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].values[0]
    paid_search_rev = segment_data[segment_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].values[0]
    diff = email_rev - paid_search_rev
    differences.append((segment, email_rev, paid_search_rev, diff))

# Create results DataFrame
differences_df = pd.DataFrame(differences, columns=['customer_segment', 'email_avg', 'paid_search_avg', 'difference'])

# Compute overall average revenue by channel (after filtering)
overall_avg_email = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_clean'].mean()
overall_avg_paid_search = df_filtered[df_filtered['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print summary
print(f'Overall average revenue by channel (after filtering):')
print(f'Email: {overall_avg_email:.2f}')
print(f'Paid Search: {overall_avg_paid_search:.2f}')
print(f'\nDifference (email - paid_search) overall: {overall_avg_email - overall_avg_paid_search:.2f}')

print(f'\nDifference in average revenue (email - paid_search) by segment:')
print(differences_df)"}
